title: [3.0beta7] In-app notification gets "stuck" sometimes
body:
Have noticed some times the notification inside AAPS won't snooze when button is pressed, even when pressing multiple times. It takes an Exit from application before they disappear. Managed to catch one on screen recording, but unfortunately I don't have logs.
